entities.name: Phosphatidylserine decarboxylase
observations: The 666-aa query has strong homology to reviewed Arabidopsis phosphatidylserine decarboxylase proenzymes (68.4–74.4% identity; 82–98% query coverage).
Query contains the PS_Dcarbxylase domain (PF02666; residues 437–632).
Likely EC 4.1.1.65 enzyme: decarboxylates phosphatidylserine to phosphatidylethanolamine; assignment is homology-supported rather than direct biochemical evidence for the query.

entities.name: PS decarboxylation
observations: Reference annotations indicate a covalently bound pyruvoyl group per subunit, generated by proenzyme autoprocessing.
